latest_release.body:
## [21.2.4](https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/compare/v21.2.3...v21.2.4) (2026-10-18)

### Bug Fixes

* fix(load): replace config file arrays with seed arrays by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/5056
* fix: update dependency jsonc to v3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/5020

### Performance Improvements


* perf(load): load typescript configs with jiti directly by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/5052

### Docs, etc

* docs: add AGENTS.md with commit type guidance by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/5053
* test(ensure): pin case conversion of digits, punctuation and accents by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/5055


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/compare/v21.2.3...v21.2.4
